basic_details.job_title: TISS Office Attendant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The application fee is to be paid online. The application will be valid only on receipt of application fee for those who are required to pay. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: The age limit is preferably between 25-35 Years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | office attendant: H S C Pass. Courteous, pleasant and initiates help and support when necessary.

selection_process: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for Written
or skill test for evaluating their proficiency and skills. Shortlisted candidates will be informed over e-mail and/or mobile phone to appear for the Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS
how_to_apply: Go to the official website at www.tiss.ac.in.
Locate the online application link provided along with the Office Attendant advertisement.
Fill in the online application form with the desired information.
Upload required certificates and documents, including category certificates if applicable.
Submit the online application form on or before 16-10-2026.
Take a print of the acknowledgment of online application and keep it for future reference.
important_instructions: The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories and female candidates are encouraged to apply. No queries or correspondence regarding selection of candidates will be entertained at any stage. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to the candidate being debarred. Candidates must assess their own eligibility before applying; suppression of facts or false documents will lead to disqualification. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview. Selected candidates are expected to join duty within 10 days of receipt of the appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: TISS Office Attendant Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is to be paid online. The application will be valid only on receipt of application fee for those who are required to pay. Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: TISS Office Attendant Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for Written, Personal Interaction, or skill test for evaluating their proficiency and skills. Shortlisted candidates will be informed over e-mail and/or mobile phone to appear for the Personal Interaction to be conducted at TISS, Guwahati.

content_sections.heading: TISS Office Attendant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to reserved categories and female candidates are encouraged to apply. No queries or correspondence regarding selection of candidates will be entertained at any stage. Canvassing in any form is strictly prohibited and will lead to the candidate being debarred. Candidates must assess their own eligibility before applying; suppression of facts or false documents will lead to disqualification. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview. Selected candidates are expected to join duty within 10 days of receipt of the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited under notification Admn/NT/TISS-GC/2026?
faq.answer: Applications are invited for the post of Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date of filling of online applications is 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be H S C Pass and courteous, pleasant, and initiate help and support when necessary.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably between 25-35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 18000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location is Guwahati Campus.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for general candidates, Rs. 250/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates who upload required certificates, and women applicants are exempted.

faq.question: Q10. When is the tentative interview date?
faq.answer: The tentative date of interview is the 3rd week of October 2026.
